title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and quickstarts; docs updates
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts across examples and docs. No breaking changes. Improves onboarding for retrieval+tool-calling use cases; includes TS/Python snippets and docs site updates.
description: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and quickstarts; docs updates. Motivation: provide opinionated RAG agent templates and end-to-end quickstarts to help developers adopt tool-calling and retrieval-augmented generation patterns with Redwood. This PR includes three curated agent templates (QA, summarizer, assisted-search), TypeScript and Python example apps that wire embeddings + a simple retriever, docs site quickstart pages with copy + runnable snippets, and small runtime helper code used only in examples to standardize tool invocation. Checklist: - [x] Add templates and examples - [x] Add docs quickstarts and redirects - [x] Add unit/integration tests for examples - [x] Update docs sidebar and search index - [x] Add migration notes for existing examples. Related work: Linear ENG-4782, ENG-4810. Testing: CI unit/integration passed, manual smoke test against sample dataset (faq corpus) validated retrieval relevance and tool calling. Breaking changes: none. Notes: left one follow-up to improve example dataset sanitization and add more tool mocks under redwood-examples (tracked ENG-4839).
